question: Estimate monthly footwear sales (organized + branded) in a single Tier 2 city like Coimbatore.
idealClarificationQuestions: Organized + branded footwear (Bata, Liberty, Khadims, Metro, Adidas, Nike, Puma, Reebok, Skechers, Crocs etc.)? Yes — excludes unorganized cobbler-bought.
All categories: casual + formal + sports + ethnic? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Population × annual pairs per capita × organized share.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Indian footwear market: ~₹75,000 Cr (FY26); organized share ~50% = ₹37,500 Cr.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Per-capita organized footwear: ~6 pairs/year avg (urban higher, rural lower).

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~50% (Tier 2 organized share slightly lower) = ~6-7 lakh pairs/month.

calculationFlow: Indian footwear market: ~₹75,000 Cr (FY26); organized share ~50% = ₹37,500 Cr.
Annual pairs (organized): ~80 crore pairs at avg ₹450/pair.
Annual pairs Coimbatore: 22 lakh × 7 = ~1.5 crore pairs/year.
Of which organized: ~50% (Tier 2 organized share slightly lower) = ~6-7 lakh pairs/month.
